# Colby Mainard — Personal Website

> Personal website of Colby Mainard, a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and AI. The site presents work history, education, technical skills, projects, certifications, hobbies, technical opinions, and curated technical reading recommendations.

> Last updated: 2026-06-20

Colby Mainard is an experienced AI/ML Engineer.
He also holds a Masters in Computer Science from Texas A&M University with a focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision. 
This is further supported by his Bachelors of Science in Computer Science from Texas A&M University, with double minors in Business and Cybersecurity.

Canonical domain: https://colbymainard.github.io

## Important notes:

- Website is static (e.g. no API).
- Site contains custom HTML, CSS, and client-side JS only.

## Intended audience

- Potential colleagues
- Technical recruiters
- Fellow AI/ML enthusiasts
- Computer Science students
- Those interested in artificial intelligence and machine learning

## Pages

- [Home / Professional Background](https://colbymainard.github.io/index.html): Work history, education, projects, certifications, technical skills, contact info.
- [Technical Stances](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_takes.html): Long-form opinion pieces on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, cryptocurrency security, the future of quantum computing, AGI hype, post-internet privacy, and product placement in sports marketing.
- [Hobbies](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/hobbies.html): Photography, quantum computing self-study, Dungeons & Dragons, history.
- [Technical Resources](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_resources.html): Curated reading list and resources covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, C/C++, Python, scripting, and operating systems.
- [Guides](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/guides.html): Plain-spoken starter guides covering data engineering, computer vision, generative AI, NLP, reinforcement learning, software engineering, and cybersecurity.

### Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/privacy.html): Site privacy policy.
